report.summary: Primary-agent read-only fallback review passed strict mode. The implementation satisfies AC-1 through AC-4 and preserves the required GET query/POST JSON mutation protocol. Customer persistence exposes name, email, company, status and notes; inputs are validated; stored email is normalized and guarded by an ignore-case uniqueness check plus a unique database constraint; status is constrained to ACTIVE or INACTIVE; list search escapes LIKE metacharacters and supports status filtering; summary counts are derived from persisted statuses. The Vue panel supports loading, search, status filtering, create, edit and delete with the generated API client, and tests plus coverage materially exercise these paths. I inspected the frozen diff, requirements, plan, quality evidence and product source without modifying the product or worktrees. Native Review Agent execution was attempted twice through existing collaboration agents but produced no result and is explicitly not-run; this report is the primary agent's read-only fallback.
